beats.title: Firstborn and Familiar Seats
beats.boundaryReason: Opening audience-only cutaway and recap lead into the four characters describing their feelings in the cockpit; active control experiments begin next.

beats.title: Learning to Move Together
beats.boundaryReason: The group tests coordinated movement, moving outside the chairs, and calling up a manual; the next deliberate experiment changes the objective to seeing through the statue.

beats.title: The Wanderer’s First Steps
beats.boundaryReason: Sight unlocks, coordinated walking and water experiments follow, and the DM explains each pilot’s contribution; Oru’s summons interrupts the practice.

beats.title: Oru Calls Them Ashore
beats.boundaryReason: Oru summons the group to a crashed vessel; they approach as the Wanderer, struggle to communicate, then leave and stop bystanders entering the dangerous eye.

beats.title: Strangers from Beyond the Storm
beats.boundaryReason: The crash-site encounter establishes telepathic communication, the visitors’ names and origin, and their reverence for the Firstborn; Sculpit then turns to demonstrating the egg experience.

beats.title: An Invitation to Stay
beats.boundaryReason: Sculpit reenacts the egg encounter amid restaurant talk; the visitors describe hardship outside the storm and receive an invitation to settle here, before the warning becomes urgent.

beats.title: The Warning Becomes Real
beats.boundaryReason: The visitors detect imminent danger, the islanders are sent to shelter, and the party returns to the Wanderer as a dreadnought breaches the storm; combat procedure follows.

beats.title: Laser Eyes Against the Dreadnought
beats.boundaryReason: Combat opens with fighter attacks, a grasping hand, psychic magic, a shoulder hit, Dispel Magic, and the Wanderer’s first laser strike against the shield; a new defensive tactic begins next.

beats.title: Mirrors, Sound, and a Giant Fist
beats.boundaryReason: The party creates mirror images and a sound shield, enlarges the Wanderer, witnesses the village being hit, and breaks the dreadnought’s shield with a punch.

beats.title: Tearing Through the Cockpit
beats.boundaryReason: Lightning and call-and-response disrupt the attackers; a new shield is discovered, the village is hit again, and a Hunter’s Pounce rips out the pilot before the allies’ craft falls.

beats.title: The Wanderer’s Finishing Leap
beats.boundaryReason: The party controls the remaining fighter, distracts another gun, discovers jumping, and combines the enlarged Wanderer with a stone maul to bring down the dreadnought.

beats.title: Aksha Lost, Shai Saved
beats.boundaryReason: A short but distinct post-combat triage scene resolves the travelers’ fates and reveals hundreds of living beings in the wreck; entering that wreck starts a new location and rescue objective.

beats.title: Rescue from the Dying Dreadnought
beats.boundaryReason: The party enters the specimen vault, frees captives and about twenty eggs under an explosion deadline, escapes, and returns to Shai for his closing warning.
